# AMC Clay Panel

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: bold · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A claymorphism region: a pillowy, softly lit panel with the title in a raised clay pill, the icon in a glossy clay bubble and the native content in a gently pressed tray.

**Use it for:** Friendly, consumer-style pages: a self-service portal Form, a Cards or KPI region, a Chart on a personal dashboard, or a short Classic Report.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_clay_panel.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-clay-panel.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Clay Panel**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-clay-panel }`.

Region template in claymorphism style. Its inner and outer shadows are mixed from the palette color and the page background, so the clay follows the theme and dark styles. The title sits in a raised pill and the region icon in a glossy bubble; the native region sits in a slightly pressed tray with a solid surface so reports and forms stay readable. Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create buttons sit in the header, Previous, Close and Next in the footer. Template options tint the clay success, danger, warm or neutral, or remove the tray padding. On hover or focus the panel puffs up and the bubble squishes; under reduced motion nothing moves. In forced-colors mode the shadows are replaced by system borders.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Success clay | `amc-TClayPanel--success` | Clay, pill and bubble use the success palette color. |
| Danger clay | `amc-TClayPanel--danger` | Clay, pill and bubble use the danger palette color, for alerts that still feel friendly. |
| Warm clay | `amc-TClayPanel--warm` | Warm clay from the warning palette color. |
| Neutral clay | `amc-TClayPanel--neutral` | Uncolored clay mixed from the text and page colors; keeps the icon bubble in the primary color. |
| No body padding | `amc-TClayPanel--noPadding` | Removes padding inside the tray so reports run edge to edge. |
